_note: Indicative export FOB ranges (USD/kg) compiled by the Nidhi Farms desk from public seller asks, rate cards and trade blogs. ESTIMATES, not quotes, not transaction prices. Only products whose estimated export economics are positive are listed.

curry.basis: Seller asks only (go4WorldBusiness, Botanika); outlier excluded

jaggery_powder.basis: Powder, MOQ 10 MT, May 2026 (older); organic excluded

bajra.basis: Food grade, Tradologie band cited 14 Jul 2026 (older); feed grade lower

small_millets.basis: 'Small millets' band, likely cleaned/dehulled grain, cited 14 Jul 2026 (older)

khapli.basis: ONE emmer-flour shipment to Singapore, 3 Jan 2026: a single data point, not a market price

coconut_oil.basis: Coconut oil FOB Cochin index, Aug 2026 (latest monthly; older)

vetiver.basis: Standard dried root; premium washed root quoted higher; 2 thin sources
